ast.scope: Explicit gap: no syntax projection or semantic AST.

obernants.scope: U is positive-cap input/job-completion vectors paired with returned results. R joins every worker and concatenates in spawn order. U minus R contains Ok after a joined panic and Ok with a permutation different from ordered concatenation, under normal allocation/unwind.
Given y and deterministic f, each compatible x has length len(y) and x_i in f^-1(y_i). All compatible positive caps remain possible because output omits partition boundaries.
For c=max(ceil(n/t),1), worker j covers [jc,min((j+1)c,n)). These intervals partition [0,n); n=0 spawns zero workers.
Err retains existence of at least one join panic but discards worker index, payload and successful outputs. par_map changes the observation to an expect panic; completed effects are not reversed.

coverage.description: Compute cap-bounded chunk size; spawn slices in order, collect all joins, collect Result, then flatten.
